#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inv) {
    int n = re.size();
    int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        int j = __builtin_bswap32(i << shift);
        if (i < j) {
            swap(re[i], re[j]);
            swap(im[i], im[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cos(half), sin(half);
        double ang = 2 * M_PI / len * (inv ? -1 : 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; ++i) {
            cos[i] = cos(ang * i);
            sin[i] = sin(ang * i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; ++j) {
                double uR = re[i + j], uI = im[i + j];
                double vR = re[i + j + half] * cos[j] - im[i + j + half] * sin[j];
                double vI = re[i + j + half] * sin[j] + im[i + j + half] * cos[j];
                re[i + j] = uR + vR;
                im[i + j] = uI + vI;
                re[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                im[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
}

vector<int> mul(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 2;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    vector<double> ar(n, 0.0), ai(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); ++i) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(ar, ai, false);
    vector<double> br(n, 0.0), bi(n, 0.0);
    if (&a == &b) {
        br = ar;
        bi = ai;
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); ++i) {
            int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            br[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bi[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(br, bi, false);
    }
    vector<double> cr(n, 0.0), ci(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> dr(n, 0.0), di(n, 0.0);
    double inv = 0.25 / n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = ar[i] + ar[j], a1i = ai[i] - ai[j];
        double a2r = ai[i] + ai[j], a2i = ar[j] - ar[i];
        double b1r = (br[i] + br[j]) * inv, b1i = (bi[i] - bi[j]) * inv;
        double b2r = (bi[i] + bi[j]) * inv, b2i = (br[j] - br[i]) * inv;
        cr[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        ci[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
        dr[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        di[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }
    fft(cr, ci, true);
    fft(dr, di, true);
    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; ++i) {
        long long rr = (long long)(cr[i] + 0.5);
        long long ss = (long long)(dr[i] + 0.5);
        long long tt = (long long)(ci[i] + 0.5);
        res[i] = (int)((rr + ((ss % mod) << 15) + ((tt % mod) << 30)) % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

class FastInput {
public:
    FastInput() : pos(0), size(0) {}
    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatch");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }
private:
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1024;
    char buf[BUF_SIZE];
    int pos;
    int size;
    int read() {
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, stdin);
            if (size <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }
    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastInput in;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        v[in.nextInt()] = 1;
    }
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int exp = n >> 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) ans = mul(ans, v, MOD);
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp > 0) v = mul(v, v, MOD);
    }
    long long total = 0;
    for (int val : ans) total = (total + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    cout << (int)total << endl;
    return 0;
}
